title: Find and remove the liveness race in the F-029 descendant-process test
goal: The test decides on one observation per process and fails only when a descendant really survives the group timeout
acceptance: A committed test or measurement shows the cause of the CI failure of run 43286749372 before any change to the test
A real surviving descendant still fails the test; no assertion is weakened
Repeated Linux CI coverage runs pass
validation: npm run test:coverage on Linux CI
escalation: A real descendant leak in the runner is reported under F-029 before the test is touched

effort.basis: Estimated 2026-11-12: read the runner's group termination, reproduce under load on Linux, one bounded test change. Not a measurement.
